title: STAIRS-Former: Spatio-Temporal Attention with Interleaved Recursive Structure Transformer for Offline Multi-task Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2603.11691v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) with multi-task datasets is challenging due to varying numbers of agents across tasks and the need to generalize to unseen scenarios. Prior works employ transformers with observation tokenization and hierarchical skill learning to address these issues. However, they underutilize the transformer attention mechanism for inter-agent coordination and rely on a single history token, which limits their ability to capture long-horizon temporal dependencies in partially observable MARL settings. In this paper, we propose STAIRS-Former, a transformer architecture augmented with spatial and temporal hierarchies that enables effective attention over critical tokens while capturing long interaction histories. We further introduce token dropout to enhance robustness and generalization across varying agent populations. Extensive experiments on diverse multi-agent benchmarks, including SMAC, SMAC-v2

translated_title: STAIRS-Former：面向离线多任务多智能体强化学习的交错递归结构时空注意力Transformer
translated_abstract: 使用多任务数据集的离线多智能体强化学习（MARL）由于各任务中智能体数量不同以及需要泛化到未见场景而极具挑战性。先前的工作采用带有观测标记化和分层技能学习的Transformer来解决这些问题。然而，这些方法未能充分利用Transformer注意力机制来实现智能体间的协调，并且仅依赖单一的历史标记，这限制了它们在部分可观测MARL环境中捕捉长时程时间依赖关系的能力。本文提出STAIRS-Former，这是一种通过空间和时间层次结构增强的Transformer架构，能够在捕捉长交互历史的同时对关键标记进行有效的注意力计算。我们进一步引入标记丢弃机制，以增强模型在不同智能体数量下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。在包括SMAC、SMAC-v2在内的多样化多智能体基准上进行了大量实验。
tldr: 本文提出STAIRS-Former，一种具有空间和时间层次结构的Transformer架构，通过对关键标记的有效注意力和标记丢弃机制，捕捉长交互历史并泛化到不同智能体数量的场景，从而提升离线多任务多智能体强化学习的性能。
en_tdlr: We propose STAIRS-Former, a transformer architecture with spatial and temporal hierarchies and token dropout that enables effective attention over critical tokens, captures long interaction histories, and generalizes across varying agent populations for offline multi-task multi-agent reinforcement learning.
